req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/{squadNumber} must persist updates so subsequent GET calls reflect the change. The source reveals a deliberate bug: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (the try block returns False instead of True), causing the route to raise HTTP 500. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid full update returns 204 and GET reflects new data; (2) negative NEG — mismatched squad_number in body vs path returns 400; (3) negative NEG — non-existent squad_number returns 404; (4) DT — body squad_number matches path but player absent; (5) BVA — squad_number boundary at lowest existing value (1) and one below (0, non-existent); (6) STC — state transition: create then update then GET verifies persistence. The bug (always-False return) means the positive test will catch the 500 mutation. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update
preconditions: DB contains player with squadNumber=10 (Lionel Messi)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with fully updated body (same squad_number=10, changed first_name, last_name, position)
expected: GET response body reflects updated first_name, last_name, position
GET response body squad_number is exactly 10
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Leo",
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "lastName": "Messi-Updated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "LW",
        "team": "Inter Miami",
        "league": "MLS",
        "starting11": True
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Leo"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Messi-Updated"
    assert body["position"] == "Left Winger"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 10
    assert body["team"] == "Inter Miami"
    assert body["league"] == "MLS"
    assert body["starting11"] is True

test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update()

tests.name: test_put_state_transition_create_then_update_then_get
preconditions: DB does NOT contain a player with squadNumber=50
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ to create player with squadNumber=50
PUT /players/squadnumber/50 with updated lastName and position
GET /players/squadnumber/50 to verify updated state persisted
expected: GET body lastName equals updated value
GET body position equals updated value
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_state_transition_create_then_update_then_get():
    create_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "PlayerOriginal",
        "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    post_resp = client.post("/players/", json=create_payload)
    assert post_resp.status_code == 201
    update_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "PlayerUpdated",
        "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CB",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/50", json=update_payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["lastName"] == "PlayerUpdated"
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Back"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body["starting11"] is True

test_put_state_transition_create_then_update_then_get()
